verdict.rationale: The only templating evidence is Logseq's own `:quick-capture-templates` config for the logseq:// quick-capture action. It defines a reusable text template with substitution variables like {time}, {text} and {url}, so templating exists but is narrowly scoped to quick capture. Auto-created dated Journals pages are not user-defined templates and earn no credit. missing for 10: general-purpose user-defined page/block templates, a documented way to apply a template when creating a new note, date and title variables specifically, in-depth template docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can define reusable templates (with variables like date and title) and apply them when creating recurring kinds of notes

citations.quote: Quick capture for short text and links. Can be added as a bookmark link to modern browser or opened from command line shell
